## Checklist

- [ ] The change was made in a source file -- `src/palette.ts`, `src/colors/*.ts`, or `src/glass/*.css` -- **never** by hand-editing generated `themes/*.json` or `glass/glass.css` directly.
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` and committed the regenerated `themes/` and `glass/` output.
- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm run audit:coverage`, and `npm run audit:contrast` all pass (or a new failure is justified with an entry in `scripts/contrast-allowlist.json`, with a reason).
- [ ] For a visual change: before/after screenshots are attached below, for every affected theme variant.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `[Unreleased]`.
